checksumSchemes.checkpoint.records.rawSha256: SHA-256 of the stored UTF-8 individual source JSON file bytes (pretty JSON).
checksumSchemes.prepared.index.records.rawSha256: The same mirror source-file byte checksum; links each derived record to its immutable raw object.
checksumSchemes.prepared.index.records.recordSha256: SHA-256 of the stored UTF-8 normalized record file bytes.
checksumSchemes.ContentRecord.rawSha256: SHA-256 of JavaScript JSON.stringify(parsedSourceObject), as UTF-8; compact serialization, not RFC 8785 canonical JSON.
checksumSchemes.ContentRecord.contentSha256: SHA-256 of the sanitized HTML string, as UTF-8.
checksumSchemes.preparedIndexSha256: SHA-256 of the complete prepared manifest file bytes; the immutable filename has the same checksum.

migration_preservation.httpRequestCountScope: Successful responses durably recorded in the checkpoint only; interrupted in-flight attempts may not be counted.

redirectReview.format: Cloudflare Bulk Redirects CSV (no header, all seven columns explicit)
redirectReview.aliases: Explicit HTTP/HTTPS and trailing-slash/slashless variants; no wildcard matching.
requiredBeforeActivation: Complete restorable hosting backup, uploads mirror and isolated restore verification
Per-record editorial and cutover approvals tied to the actual content hashes
Every target deployed with verified 200, correct canonical and approved indexing state
Scoped blog-host redirect authority, account capacity check and explicit activation review
Cloudflare edge trace of HTTP/HTTPS and both slash forms to prevent HTTPS/slash normalization before the direct redirect

freshPublicTotalsCheck.scope: Fresh public REST totals only; preservation completeness refers to the inventoried corpus. Matching totals do not establish a publishing freeze or unchanged content.
